remarks: Great South Wilton location and award winning Wilton schools! Move right into this bright 3 bedroom ranch style unit with 2 full baths; sun filled eat-in-kitchen with vaulted ceiling, skylight, and dining area; large living room; plus den/office with laundry - all conveniently on one level. This rental includes the use of the one car garage and pull-down attic storage; plus includes electric, water, hot water, trash, landscape, mowing, plowing, and maintenance of the furnace. Tenant to pay for oil and cable only. Pets considered on case by case basis. Tenant has use of the front and side yard (backyard for the other unit). Available immediately!
